9.1 Your Thread Sees Four Endings, and Each Says What the Host Knows

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-ignore-iso-exceptions: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-ignore-iso-exceptions: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-ignore-iso-exceptions: 9.2 says QMUX doesn't pack and the sender thread does; the ignore-iso-exceptions=yes run shows the bad purchase 000202 getting null with the link still up, and the text says it 'waits five seconds for a null that means "unknown" when the truth is "never sent"', so a reader picks b.
recorded.prompt:q-duplicate-key: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-duplicate-key: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-duplicate-key: 9.1: 'An ISOException from request means QMUX refused the message before queueing it. The host saw nothing. ... if the key was a duplicate, send it again with a new STAN.' The table and the Reference say the same.
recorded.prompt:q-unlisted-code: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unlisted-code: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unlisted-code: 9.3: 'No field 39, or a code you don't know, says nothing about the money. Treat it as no answer, and reverse.' AnswerPolicy's getOrDefault(rc, Next.REVERSE) and the Reference row 'none, or not on the list -> REVERSE' say the same.
recorded.prompt:q-listener-throws: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-listener-throws: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-listener-throws: 9.4 says request listeners are 'called the same way, for every message no request is waiting for' on the receiver thread, that 'nothing on the way catches a runtime exception', and that the receiver's catch 'reconnects. Every answer still in the socket is lost, and each of those purchases returns null.'

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-ignore-iso-exceptions:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-ignore-iso-exceptions:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-ignore-iso-exceptions:a: 9.2: 'QMUX doesn't pack. It puts the ISOMsg on the adaptor's queue, and the adaptor's sender thread packs it.'
recorded.prompt:q-ignore-iso-exceptions:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-ignore-iso-exceptions:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-ignore-iso-exceptions:c: 9.2's ignore-iso-exceptions run shows '000202 (bad): null', and 'Nothing threw in the calling thread', so no ISOException is handed back to the caller.
recorded.prompt:q-ignore-iso-exceptions:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-ignore-iso-exceptions:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-ignore-iso-exceptions:d: 9.2 says the truth for the bad purchase is 'never sent', and the Preflight output shows the packager throwing 'error packing field 43' for an over-long field rather than cutting it. Applying that to field 41 is a short inference from 'A packager checks lengths'.
recorded.prompt:q-duplicate-key:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-duplicate-key:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-duplicate-key:b: 9.1 says the message was refused, never queued, and must be sent again with a new STAN, so no answer is on its way. By short inference, waiting for one is wrong.
recorded.prompt:q-duplicate-key:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-duplicate-key:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-duplicate-key:c: 9.1: QMUX refused it 'before queueing it', so the adaptor never took it, and the Reference says the host saw it: 'no'.
recorded.prompt:q-duplicate-key:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-duplicate-key:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-duplicate-key:d: 9.1: 'The host saw nothing', and its example run shows 'same key host received 0', so nothing was sent and there is nothing to reverse.
recorded.prompt:q-unlisted-code:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unlisted-code:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unlisted-code:a: 9.3 and 9.8 say an unknown code should be reversed, not declined: 'if the unreadable answer was an approval, the cardholder has paid for goods they didn't get, and nothing in your system will notice.'
recorded.prompt:q-unlisted-code:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unlisted-code:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unlisted-code:b: 9.3: 'Sending the same purchase again would charge twice if the first was approved.'
recorded.prompt:q-unlisted-code:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-unlisted-code:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-unlisted-code:c: 9.8: 'A decline needs nothing more from you, so if the unreadable answer was an approval ... nothing in your system will notice.' Section 9.3 makes the same point about 08.
recorded.prompt:q-listener-throws:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-listener-throws:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-listener-throws:a: 9.4: 'nothing on the way catches a runtime exception'; it ends in the receiver's catch and the link drops, so the purchases are affected. The page never shows QMUX answering a message on its own.
recorded.prompt:q-listener-throws:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-listener-throws:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-listener-throws:b: 9.4: the receiver's own catch (Exception e) reconnects, not QMUX, and the waiting purchases each return null ('the thread that called request gets null like any lost answer'), not an ISOException.
recorded.prompt:q-listener-throws:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-listener-throws:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-listener-throws:d: 9.4: nothing between the receiver and the listener catches the exception, and the link drops. The page says a message goes on to <unhandled> only when a listener returns false from process.
